What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators need to have a clear understanding of their target audience, their digital products, and their pricing strategy. They also need to have a basic knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, as well as a reliable internet connection. Additionally, creators should familiarize themselves with the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Once they have these basics covered, creators can confidently deploy their stack and start collecting payments from their customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

First, creators need to integrate NOWPayments with their digital product hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, they need to configure the payment settings, including the cryptocurrency accepted, the payment amount, and the delivery parameters. Finally, creators need to test their pipeline to ensure that payments are processed correctly and digital products are delivered to customers as expected.
